●本商品の対象年齢は15才以上です。 対象年齢未満のお子様には絶対に与えないでください。 ●小さな部品、電池がありますので、小さなお子様が誤って飲み込
まないように注意してください。 窒息などの危険があります。 耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を損なう恐れがあります。 ●可動部分には指
などを入れないでください。 はさまれてケガをする恐れがあります。●LEDの光の点滅を見続けないでください。気分が悪くなったりするおそれがあります。●本商品に
は電子部品を使用しておりますので、ペースメーカーをご使用の方はご注意ください。 《電池を誤使用すると発熱・破裂・液漏れの恐れがあります。 下記に注意してく
ださい》 二次電池(充電式電池) は、絶対に使用しないでください。 ●古い電池と新しい電池、いろいろな種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。 ●十一 (プラスマ
イナス)を正しくセットしてください。 ●遊んだ後は必ずスイッチを切り電池をはずしてください。 電池を入れたままにしておくと、液漏れの恐れがあり危険です。 ●ショー
トさせたり充電、分解、 加熱、 火の中に入れたりしないでください。 ●万一、電池を飲み込んだとき、電池から漏れた液が目に入ったときは、すぐに医師に相談してくだ
さい。漏れた液が皮膚や服に付いたときは水で洗ってください。 ボタン電池は飲み込むと危険です。 お子様の手の届かない所に保管してください。 廃棄するとき
は、 自治体の廃棄物処理の指示に従ってください。
blocks.translation:
• The intended age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give it to children younger than the intended age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that young children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. There is a risk of being pinched and injured.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause nausea or other ill effects.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• If you misuse batteries they can heat up, rupture, or leak. Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Set the polarity correctly (plus/minus).
• Always turn the switch off and remove the batteries after play. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If a battery is swallowed or battery leakage gets into the eyes, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of reach of children.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• The buckle is fully painted. Depending on how you handle it, the paint may get scratched or peel off, so take care.
• The battery installed in the Gaia Memory is for testing. Replace the battery if the sound becomes faint or the light grows weak.
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where temperatures become very high or very low.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts strongly in a direction they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• Do not insert anything other than the Gaia Memory into the main unit; doing so may cause malfunction. Inserting commercially available USB memory devices may cause damage. Also, the included Gaia Memory cannot be used with computers.
• If the unit malfunctions, press the reset button and turn the power back on.
• Appearance may vary between units due to the product's characteristics.
• Do not insert the included Gaia Memory into products other than compatible items such as CSM Double Driver ver.2 or CSM Double Driver ver.1.5.
• The product may malfunction from other infrared remotes such as TV remotes.
• The product may malfunction outdoors in direct sunlight. Play with it indoors. If it malfunctions, turn the power off and on again.

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れます。

ダブルドライバー2つを使って、
ドライバー間の通信遊びを
行うモード

• Use two Double Drivers to play communication games between the drivers.

blocks.text:

「メモリ転送音」が付加された
変身遊びを行うモード

DX版と同じように遊ぶモード

blocks.text: ドライバーとメモリの通信連動について
blocks.translation: About communication between the Driver and Memory

blocks.text:
ガイアメモリ ver.2は、ドライバー(左右)が閉じている状態のダブルドライバー本体と赤外線通信を行います。
メモリを装填した際の 「装填音」が鳴り終わるまで通信を行う為、 「装填音」が鳴り終わる前にドライバー(左右)を展開すると通信が
失敗する場合がございます。
blocks.translation:
• Gaia Memory ver.2 communicates by infrared with the Double Driver main unit while the driver (left/right) is closed.
• The unit keeps communicating until the “insertion sound” that plays when a memory is loaded finishes, so if you open the driver (left/right) before that sound ends, communication may fail.

blocks.translation:
• If communication fails, firmly close the Driver and wait until the “close” sound finishes, then open it again.
• When communication fails, a memory with a silver terminal will play the voice it would make when loaded in the Driver (right), and a memory with a gold terminal will play the voice it would make when loaded in the Driver (left).
• If communication keeps failing, replace the batteries and try again.
• Communication only occurs while the Driver is closed. If you swap memories while the Driver is open, it will not recognize the form.
• Direct sunlight can prevent the infrared sensor from responding properly and may cause communication to fail. Play indoors out of direct sunlight.

* Once a finisher is selected, the Memory will retain that selected finisher until it enters sleep mode. To select a different finisher, repeat the procedure from step 1 above.
* If the finisher sound does not play, communication between the Memory and the Driver may have failed. Close the Driver once, and after the "closing" sound has finished playing, expand it again.

blocks.text: <変身前状態>① 通常台詞遊び

<変身前状態>でフィリップ台詞ボタンまたは翔太郎台詞ボタンを短押しします。
下記表の「フィリップ変身前台詞」/「翔太郎変身前台詞」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
In the <pre-transformation state>, briefly press the Philip line button or the Shotaro line button.
The “Philip pre-transformation line” or the “Shotaro pre-transformation line” from the table below will play.

blocks.text:
※正しい台詞が鳴らない場合、メモリとドライバーの通信が失敗してる可能性があります。
一度ドライバーを閉じ、 「閉じ音」が鳴り終わった後に再度展開してください。
blocks.translation:
• If the correct lines do not play, communication between the memory and the driver may have failed.
• Close the driver once, wait until the "closing" sound finishes, then open it again.

blocks.text: それを言うならが、だろ?
blocks.translation: If that's what you're saying, then it's you, right?

blocks.text: あの日と同じ事を、今もう一度くよ、 翔太郎。 これからも、悪魔と相乗りする勇気、 あるかな?
blocks.translation:
• I'll ask you the same thing I did that day, Shoutarou.
• Do you still have the courage to ride with a devil?

blocks.text: いきなりヒートで行こう。
それがもし、弱さだとしても、僕は受け容れる。
blocks.translation: Even if that is a weakness, I will accept it.

blocks.text: 止めるさ。 何度でも。 この左翔太郎が街にいるかぎり。
blocks.translation: I'll stop you. No matter how many times. As long as I'm in this town.

blocks.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の・・・。
blocks.translation: Here we go, Shoutarou... the last one.

blocks.text:
翔太郎台ボタン:短押し
台同
止めてやるよ。 俺が、・・・いや、俺が。
blocks.translation: I'll stop you. Me... no, I'll do it.

blocks.text: 止めてやるよ俺が必ず。
blocks.translation: I'll stop you. I will, no matter what.

blocks.text: 約束を守っただけだよ

たとえおまえらがどんなに強大なでも、風邪を泣かせるヤツは許さねえ。ひとつになってもらい
ついて倒す、その心そのものが仮面ライダーなんだ。この街には仮面ライダーがいる事を忘れんなよ。
blocks.translation:
• No matter how powerful you are, I won't forgive anyone who makes people cry.
• Even with nothing but my body, I'll latch on and take you down—that very spirit is what a Kamen Rider is.
• Don't forget that there's a Kamen Rider in this town.

blocks.text: さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!
おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。
blocks.translation: Oops—I forgot... All right, let's go, Philip.

blocks.text: フィリップ台 ボタン&翔太郎台詞ボタン: 同時短押し
blocks.translation: Philip dialogue button & Shotaro dialogue button: press both briefly at the same time.

blocks.text: たちは2人で1人の探偵さ。 行くぜフィリップ。
blocks.translation:
• The two of us make one detective.
• Let's go, Philip.

blocks.text: フィリップ台詞ボタン
魔と相乗りする勇気あるかな?
blocks.translation: Do you have the courage to share the ride with a demon?
It gives me the chills, doesn't it?

blocks.text: 行くさは2人で1人の探偵だもの。
blocks.translation: After all, the two of us are one detective.

blocks.text: おやっさんが言ってたぜ、男の仕事の8割は決断だ。 そっから先はおまけみたいなもんだってな
blocks.translation: Oyassan used to say, "Eighty percent of a man's work is making decisions. Everything after that is just an extra."

blocks.text: 俺は、いや、俺達は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。
blocks.translation: I—no, we—are Sokichi Narumi's last remaining legacy. We're two people who are one detective—and Kamen Rider.

blocks.text: フィリップ! おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何か策があるんだろうな!
blocks.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're going after Fang!? Hey, you've got a plan, right?

blocks.text: 対策なんか、働いてから立てればいい。
blocks.translation: You can figure out a plan of action after you start working.

blocks.text: 地獄の底まで、と相乗りしてくれ、翔太郎。 来い! ファング!
blocks.translation: Ride with me all the way to the depths of hell, Shotaro. Come! Fang!

blocks.text: ありがとよ・・・フィリップ・・・。
相棒、それを言うなら、 は、 だろ?
blocks.translation: Partner, if you're going to put it that way, shouldn't it be...?

blocks.text: 強いだけのダブルに価値はない。 キミの優しさが必要だ、翔太郎。
blocks.translation: There is no value in a Double that is merely strong. Your kindness is needed, Shotaro.

blocks.text: そうだった。アイツが俺を相棒と呼ぶ限り、俺は折れない。約束だった・・・。
blocks.translation: That's right. As long as he calls me his partner, I won't break. That was the promise...

blocks.text: 15 僕は人間で、 探偵で、 そして、仮面ライダーだ!
blocks.translation: 15 I am a human, a detective, and... Kamen Rider!

blocks.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ
blocks.translation: You did well on your own. That's amazing.

blocks.text: キミの友である事は、僕のりさ。
blocks.translation: Being your friend is my pride.

blocks.text:
<変身前状態>でフィリップ台詞ボタンと翔太郎台詞ボタンを同時に短押しします。
下記表の「二人の変身前掛け合い台詞」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
While in the <pre-transformation state>, briefly press both the Philip dialogue button and the Shotaro dialogue button at the same time.
The "pre-transformation dialogue exchange between the two" listed in the table below will play.

blocks.text:
翔太郎・フィリップ2人の台詞を鳴らす場合は
こちらの操作がおすすめです。
blocks.translation: If you want to play both Shotaro's and Philip's lines, we recommend this operation.

blocks.text:
フィリップ
台詞ボタン
止めてやるよ俺が。 必ず。 それを言うなら俺達が、だろ?
blocks.translation: I'll stop you. I will—definitely. If you're going to put it that way, it should be "we," right?

blocks.text: 俺は、いや、運は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。 行くぜ、フィリップ。 ああ。
blocks.translation: I'm—no, we're—the last remnant of Sokichi Narumi. We're a two‑in‑one detective and a Kamen Rider. Let's go, Philip. Yeah.

blocks.text: フィリップ!おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何かがあるんだろうな! 対策なんか、動いてから立てればいい。
blocks.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're after Fang!? Hey, you've got something planned, right? We can work out countermeasures after we move.

blocks.text: 強いだけのダブルに価値はない。 キミの優しさが必要だ、翔太郎。 それがもし、さだとしても、僕は受け容れる。 ありがとよ･･･フィリップ･･･。 行こう、相棒。
blocks.translation: A Double that's only strong has no value. I need your kindness, Shotaro. Even if that's fate, I'll accept it. Thanks... Philip... Let's go, partner.

blocks.text: 僕は人間で、 探偵で、 そして、仮面ライダーだ! 相棒、それを言うなら、僕は、だろ? あぁ。 行くよ、 翔太郎。
blocks.translation: I am human, a detective, and a Kamen Rider! Partner—if you're going to say it that way, shouldn't it be "I"? Yeah. Let's go, Shotaro.

blocks.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ。 約束を守っただけだよ。 キミの友である事は、僕の誇りさ。
blocks.translation: You did well on your own. That was amazing. I just kept my promise. I'm proud to be your friend.

blocks.text:
止めるさ。 何度でも。 この左翔太郎が街にいるかぎり。 たとえおまえらがどんなに強大な悪でも、都を泣かせるヤツは許さねえ。体ひとつになっても食らいついて倒す、その心そのものが仮面ライダーなんだ。
この街には仮面ライダーがいる事を忘れんなよ。
blocks.translation:
I'll stop you. No matter how many times. As long as I, Shotaro Hidari, am in this city. No matter how great the evil you are, I won't forgive anyone who makes this city cry. Even if I'm down to just my own body, I'll bite and bring you down—that very heart is what a Kamen Rider is.
Don't you forget: there's a Kamen Rider in this city.

blocks.text: 財団X! さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!
blocks.translation: Foundation X! Now, count your sins!

blocks.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の･･･。ああ、最後の!
blocks.translation: Here we go, Shotaro—the last one... Yeah, the last one!

blocks.text: おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。 ああ、相棒。
blocks.translation: Oops, almost forgot... Alright, let's go, Philip. Yeah, partner.

source_blocks.text: 行くさは2人で1人の探偵だもの。
source_blocks.translation: After all, the two of us are one detective.

source_blocks.text: おやっさんが言ってたぜ、男の仕事の8割は決断だ。 そっから先はおまけみたいなもんだってな
source_blocks.translation: Oyassan used to say, "Eighty percent of a man's work is making decisions. Everything after that is just an extra."

source_blocks.text: 止めてやるよ俺が必ず。
それを言うならが、だろ?
source_blocks.translation: If you're going to put it that way, then it's "ga," right?

source_blocks.text: 俺は、いや、俺達は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。
source_blocks.translation: I—no, we—are Sokichi Narumi's last remaining legacy. We're two people who are one detective—and Kamen Rider.

source_blocks.text: あの日と同じ事を、今もう一度くよ、 翔太郎。 これからも、悪魔と相乗りする勇気、 あるかな?
source_blocks.translation: I'm going to ask you the same thing I did that day, Shotaro. Do you have the courage to keep riding with a devil?

source_blocks.text: フィリップ! おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何か策があるんだろうな!
source_blocks.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're going after Fang!? Hey, you've got a plan, right?

source_blocks.text: 対策なんか、働いてから立てればいい。
source_blocks.translation: You can figure out a plan of action after you start working.

source_blocks.text: 地獄の底まで、と相乗りしてくれ、翔太郎。 来い! ファング!

source_blocks.translation: That's right. As long as he calls me his partner, I won't break. That was the promise...

rows.text: おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。
rows.translation: Oops—I forgot... All right, let's go, Philip.

27.translation:
• The two of us make one detective.
• Let's go, Philip.

rows.text: たちは2人で1人の探偵さ。 行くぜフィリップ。
rows.translation: The two of us make one detective. Let's go, Philip.

30.translation: Do you have the courage to share the ride with a demon?

rows.text: 魔と相乗りする勇気あるかな?
rows.translation: Do you have the courage to share the ride with a demon?

32.translation: It gives me the chills, doesn't it?

rows.translation: It gives me the chills, doesn't it?

42.translation: After all, the two of us are one detective.

rows.text: 行くさは2人で1人の探偵だもの。
rows.translation: After all, the two of us are one detective.

53.translation: I—no, we—are Sokichi Narumi's last remaining legacy. We're two people who are one detective—and Kamen Rider.

rows.text: 俺は、いや、俺達は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。
rows.translation: I—no, we—are Sokichi Narumi's last remaining legacy. We're two people who are one detective—and Kamen Rider.

56.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're going after Fang!? Hey, you've got a plan, right?

rows.text: フィリップ! おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何か策があるんだろうな!
rows.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're going after Fang!? Hey, you've got a plan, right?

58.translation: You can figure out a plan of action after you start working.

rows.text: 対策なんか、働いてから立てればいい。
rows.translation: You can figure out a plan of action after you start working.

62.translation: Ride with me all the way to the depths of hell, Shotaro. Come! Fang!

rows.text: 地獄の底まで、と相乗りしてくれ、翔太郎。 来い! ファング!
rows.translation: Ride with me all the way to the depths of hell, Shotaro. Come! Fang!

rows.text: ありがとよ・・・フィリップ・・・。

70.translation: Partner, if you're going to put it that way, shouldn't it be...?

rows.text: 相棒、それを言うなら、 は、 だろ?
rows.translation: Partner, if you're going to put it that way, shouldn't it be...?

73.translation: That's right. As long as he calls me his partner, I won't break. That was the promise...

rows.text: そうだった。アイツが俺を相棒と呼ぶ限り、俺は折れない。約束だった・・・。
rows.translation: That's right. As long as he calls me his partner, I won't break. That was the promise...

83.translation: You did well on your own. That's amazing.

rows.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ
rows.translation: You did well on your own. That's amazing.

85.translation: Being your friend is my pride.

rows.text: キミの友である事は、僕のりさ。
rows.translation: Being your friend is my pride.

99.translation: I'll stop you. I will—definitely. If you're going to put it that way, it should be "we," right?

rows.text: 止めてやるよ俺が。 必ず。 それを言うなら俺達が、だろ?
rows.translation: I'll stop you. I will—definitely. If you're going to put it that way, it should be "we," right?

101.translation: I'm—no, we're—the last remnant of Sokichi Narumi. We're a two‑in‑one detective and a Kamen Rider. Let's go, Philip. Yeah.

rows.text: 俺は、いや、運は、鳴海荘吉の忘れ形見。 2人で1人の探偵で、仮面ライダーだ。 行くぜ、フィリップ。 ああ。
rows.translation: I'm—no, we're—the last remnant of Sokichi Narumi. We're a two‑in‑one detective and a Kamen Rider. Let's go, Philip. Yeah.

103.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're after Fang!? Hey, you've got something planned, right? We can work out countermeasures after we move.

rows.text: フィリップ!おまえ･･･まさかファングを!? おい、何かがあるんだろうな! 対策なんか、動いてから立てればいい。
rows.translation: Philip! You... don't tell me you're after Fang!? Hey, you've got something planned, right? We can work out countermeasures after we move.

105.translation: A Double that's only strong has no value. I need your kindness, Shotaro. Even if that's fate, I'll accept it. Thanks... Philip... Let's go, partner.

rows.text: 強いだけのダブルに価値はない。 キミの優しさが必要だ、翔太郎。 それがもし、さだとしても、僕は受け容れる。 ありがとよ･･･フィリップ･･･。 行こう、相棒。
rows.translation: A Double that's only strong has no value. I need your kindness, Shotaro. Even if that's fate, I'll accept it. Thanks... Philip... Let's go, partner.

107.translation: I am human, a detective, and a Kamen Rider! Partner—if you're going to say it that way, shouldn't it be "I"? Yeah. Let's go, Shotaro.

rows.text: 僕は人間で、 探偵で、 そして、仮面ライダーだ! 相棒、それを言うなら、僕は、だろ? あぁ。 行くよ、 翔太郎。
rows.translation: I am human, a detective, and a Kamen Rider! Partner—if you're going to say it that way, shouldn't it be "I"? Yeah. Let's go, Shotaro.

109.translation: You did well on your own. That was amazing. I just kept my promise. I'm proud to be your friend.

rows.text: 1人でよくやったね。 すごいよ。 約束を守っただけだよ。 キミの友である事は、僕の誇りさ。
rows.translation: You did well on your own. That was amazing. I just kept my promise. I'm proud to be your friend.

113.translation: Foundation X! Now, count your sins!

rows.text: 財団X! さあ、おまえの罪を数えろ!
rows.translation: Foundation X! Now, count your sins!

115.translation: Here we go, Shotaro—the last one... Yeah, the last one!

rows.text: いくよ翔太郎、最後の･･･。ああ、最後の!
rows.translation: Here we go, Shotaro—the last one... Yeah, the last one!

117.translation: Oops, almost forgot... Alright, let's go, Philip. Yeah, partner.

rows.text: おっといけね、忘れてたぜ・・・さあ行こうか、フィリップ。 ああ、相棒。
rows.translation: Oops, almost forgot... Alright, let's go, Philip. Yeah, partner.

uncertainties: Unclear whether 'はら' is a proper place name (e.g., 'Hara') or a common noun; translated as a place name 'Hara' because the phrase reads like a town name.
The line begins with the particle 'を', suggesting a preceding subject is missing in the crop; the full original clause may be incomplete.
Reading and segmentation of '黒の根、現兵衛' is uncertain — it could be a single name (Kurone Genbei), two names, or a phrase; I rendered it as 'Kurone Genbei'.
Tone and nuance (e.g., exclamatory emphasis) preserved, but exact punctuation in original may differ.
Reconstructed 永遠に (eternally) from scanned 永に.
The first word is a dialectal spelling of あたりまえだろう ("of course"); rendered here as あったりめえだろう.
The second line is read as 俺はなんだ。 It might alternatively be 俺様はなんだ。 depending on the printed text; the crop is small and slightly unclear.

The source image/text showed 'は･･･' before '2人で…'; I interpreted the missing/unclear subject as '僕たち' to form a complete sentence ('僕たちは'). This reconstruction may be incorrect if the original used a different subject.
The meaning of 「ダブル」 ("Double") is unclear from the panel; it may be a proper name, item, or technical term.
The OCR text showed 'ダブルんなった' — read here as 'ダブルになった'. This reconstruction is uncertain.
The phrase '原画' may be an OCR or reading error; the intended word could be different (for example '極悪' or another descriptor). Translation preserves the literal reading 'original artwork'.
The name '琉兵衛' is romanized as Ryūbei; pronunciation is assumed from kanji but could vary.

The middle word is printed as "メモリプレイク" in the image; it may be intended as "メモリブレイク" ("Memory Break").
The final name in the second line appears as 太郎一 in the OCR; I have rendered it as 太郎ー (an elongated shout) and translated it as "Taro!" because the OCR character after 太郎 is unclear.
Romanization of 翔太郎 is given as "Shoutarou"; other valid spellings (Shoutaro, Shōtarō) may exist.
The nuance of 決めるぜ can also mean "I'll finish this" or "I'll settle this" depending on context; translated here literally as "I'll decide this, Philip."

The verb phrase 「おこるぜ」 is ambiguous in the scan. Possible readings include 起こるぜ ("will happen/come"), 怒るぜ ("I'll get angry"), or おごるぜ ("I'll treat you"). The translation assumes 起こるぜ meaning "is coming/ will happen."
The original text is a colloquial contraction; translated as the emphatic refusal “No way.” Context is limited, so nuance (sarcasm, exasperation) may be lost.

<変身前状態>でベルト(右) 未装着状態、 または装着状態で効果音ボタンを押すと、下記の音声が鳴ります。
blocks.translation: In the “Before Transformation” state, whether the belt (right) is not worn or is worn, pressing the effect sound button will play the following sounds.

blocks.text:
効果音ボタンを
短押しします。
→右記の音声が
交互に鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Press the sound-effect button briefly.
• The sounds shown on the right will play alternately.

blocks.text:
効果音ボタンを短押しします。
「ベルト出現音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Press the sound-effect button briefly.
• The "Belt Appearance Sound" will play.

blocks.text:
効果音ボタンを1秒間長押しした後、ボタンを離します。
「フィリップが倒れる音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Press and hold the sound-effects button for 1 second, then release the button.
• The “sound of Philip falling” will play.

blocks.text:
効果音ボタンを長押しします。
「ベルト装着音 (長尺版)」が鳴ります。
「ベルト装着音(長尺版)」が鳴っている間に
ベルト(右)を装着すると、「ベルト装着完了音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Press and hold the sound-effect button.
• "Belt attach sound (long version)" will play.
• If you attach the belt (right) while the "Belt attach sound (long version)" is playing, the "Belt attach complete sound" will play.

blocks.text:
※「ベルト装着音(長尺版)」を鳴らさずにベルト(右)を
装着した場合は音は鳴りません。
blocks.translation: If you attach the right belt without playing the “Belt Attachment Sound (long version)”, no sound will play.

blocks.translation:
How to play in '2' (Two-people-as-one) mode
※This play method is for '2' (Two-people-as-one) mode only. ('1': One-person Scene Recreation mode, 'O': cannot be used in DX mode.)

blocks.text: 2つのダブルドライバーの通信範囲について
blocks.translation: About the communication range between two Double Drivers

blocks.text:
2つのダブルドライバーの「赤外線送受信センサー」が向かい合った状態で、
ダブルドライバー間の距離は1m以内(障害物無し)を目安としてください。
※週信がうまくいかない場合は近づいて再度通信を行ってください。
太陽光の当たる場所では赤外線センサーが正常に反応せず、通信が失敗する可能性があります。太陽光の当たらない室内で遊んでください。
blocks.translation:
• With the two Double Drivers' infrared transmit/receive sensors facing each other, keep the distance between them within 1 m (no obstacles) as a guideline.
• If communication fails, move the units closer and try communicating again.
• Direct sunlight can prevent the infrared sensors from responding properly and may cause communication to fail. Play indoors away from direct sunlight.

(左右2箇所に搭載)
blocks.translation: Infrared transmit/receive sensor (mounted in two locations: left and right)
